_about: R. W. Emerson's (1803-1882) Essays, First and Second Series (Self-Reliance is in the First). Not the `emerson` shelf (P. H. Emerson, Welsh fairy tales). Added from the classical reading lists (Classical Conversations, Canon Press, New Saint Andrews, Logos School/Online, Bethlehem College & Seminary, Memoria Press, CiRCE): docs/reading-lists/READING-LISTS.tsv. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 (Bloom's Western Canon): emerson-nature, emerson-representative-men, emerson-conduct-life, emerson-journals, emerson-poems.

emerson-journals: Journals of Ralph Waldo Emerson, with annotations, ed. Edward Waldo Emerson and Waldo Emerson Forbes, vol. I, 1820-1824

emerson-nature.year: 1849 (copyright entry on PG title page: 'Entered ... in the year 1849'; 'New Edition', Boston & Cambridge)
emerson-nature.case: Nature is on PG; the rwemerson shelf holds only the two Essays series.
emerson-nature.note: 1849 'new edition' (Nature, Addresses, and Lectures) includes Nature itself.

emerson-representative-men.evidence: PG header read; no imprint in front matter
emerson-representative-men.case: Representative Men is on PG; not held.

emerson-conduct-life.year: 1871 (PG title page: Boston 1871; 'Entered ... in the year 1860')
emerson-conduct-life.case: The Conduct of Life is on PG; not held.
emerson-conduct-life.note: The machine's held hit (Wisdom of the East, Confucius) is a false match.

emerson-journals.year: 1909 (title page: Boston and New York, Houghton Mifflin, 1909; 'Copyright, 1909')
emerson-journals.evidence: djvu title page read; collection toronto
emerson-journals.case: The ten-volume Emerson/Forbes Journals (1909-14) was the standard edition until the Harvard JMN. All volumes are pre-1931 and on IA.
emerson-journals.note: Ten volumes. Only vol. I's title page was read; the other nine need picking from IA (e.g. the cu31924021990* Cornell series, 1909-14 per IA metadata).

emerson-poems.evidence: PG front matter lists copyright years 1867, 1876, 1883, 1895, 1904 and 1911, so this is the 1904/1911 Centenary-text Household Edition
emerson-poems.case: Emerson's poems collected (Centenary text, with appendix); not held.
emerson-poems.note: Also PG 15963 May-Day, and Other Pieces (1867).
